source: Use a deliberately hypothetical ZXNAME0000XZ so the arithmetic illustrates the mechanism without pretending to describe a specific ZXNAME0001XZ. Suppose it allows at most 64 resident warps, has enough block slots for the configurations below, and no additional allocation-granularity limit. It contains 65,536 32-bit registers and 128 KiB of shared memory.
zh: 使用故意假设的 ZXNAME0000XZ，以便算术说明该机制，而无需假装描述特定的 ZXNAME0001XZ。假设它最多允许 64 个常驻扭曲，具有足够的块槽用于以下配置，并且没有额外的分配粒度限制。它包含 65,536 个 32 位寄存器和 128 KiB 共享内存。
